title: Uncapped empirical influential coordinates
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $t$ be a positive rational influence bound, and let $\varepsilon$ be a rational with $0<\varepsilon\le 1/2$. Given, for each singleton coordinate set, a list of the prescribed sample length of pairs consisting of a sign vector of length $n$ and a sign, include a coordinate $i$ in the empirical set exactly when its empirical Fourier coefficient, computed from the samples assigned to $\{i\}$, is at least the learning threshold for $t,\varepsilon$ minus the prescribed accuracy for $t,\varepsilon$.
hypotheses_covered: samples are supplied for every singleton coordinate set and every index in the prescribed finite sample range
each sample is a pair of a length-$n$ sign vector and a sign
